summary: OceanaGold, a Canadian-listed gold miner, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a news release dated September 24, 2026, reporting high-grade drill results from 16 holes at the Wharekirauponga deposit near its Waihi operation in New Zealand and updating progress on the Waihi North Project. Intercepts include 6.3 m at 97.2 g/t gold. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated; this is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation.
